notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - The C.O.G.S. Update!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Happy Holidays! Sorry about the radio silence ever since releasing this game into Early Access. I'll be honest, for a while the game was sitting and collecting dust, but I knew it was an incomplete project. I figured if I was going to release an update, it was have to be big, and it would have to be a surprise! Luckily, the time has finally come to reveal what I have been working on!

Here's the complete list:

Holiday Themed Main Menu
As a fun way to celebrate the holiday season, for the next few weeks the main menu will be decorated with colorful lights and falling snow!

New Mechanics
A few new mechanics have been added to the game, the main ones being a power generator and distractions. Almost all of the levels in the original Early Access release have been reworked to include these new mechanics.

New Levels
The total level of levels in the game has jumped from 22 to 35! There are now 5 new easy levels, 5 new medium levels, and 3 new hard levels. Some of these levels have new clear conditions never seen in the game before!

Background Music
At long last, the music volume adjuster finally has a purpose! Classical piano will now fill your ears as you try and beat each level. Different songs will play depending on whether you are in the main menu, the tutorial, or in a level.

New Insults
The number of different insults you can receive after failing a level is now over 50! Have fun reading them all.

New Art
You may have noticed that some parts of the Steam library and store pages for the game look different. This is because I have redone all of the Steam art for the game!





And of course, there have been a few minor tweak and bug fixes.

As you can see, there is a lot of new and shiny features in this update! Also, this update brings us one step closer to coming out of Early Access and into a full release. Hooray!

I hope this update meets your expectations, and maybe even exceeds them. Thank you to everyone for your support for this project!

- Tommy Galletta, Head Insult Brainstormer Bells 'n' Whistles

notes.title: Development Update #06
notes.content:
Hello all!

I have some very, very exciting news. Bells 'n' Whistles will officially be releasing into Early Access on July 30th at 3:00pm EST. 

Here's a short run-down of all of the main features the Early Access release will include:


 Point and click mechanics
 Over 20 levels
 A steep difficulty curve
 A fully fledged tutorial mode
 Several Steam achievements, including some hidden ones!


In the coming weeks before the Early Access release, I will also be overhauling a majority of the store page, as the game has evolved a lot since the initial creation of the store page. That include adding an official trailer for the game!

I hope you are all as excited as I am. I'll see you guys on the 30th!

- Tommy Galletta, Father of Bells 'n' Whistles

notes.title: Development Update #05
notes.content:
So...

It has been a while, hasn't it? Sadly, I have not been able to work on this project as much as I would like to. The goal of an end of May or early June release has clearly not come to fruition. However, I'm not giving up on this project or anything. I just need a bit more time. To those who have been waiting for this game, I apologize. There's not much more I can do besides apologizing.

Well, I guess I COULD work on the game, that might help.

Anyways, I hope everyone who reads this is doing well. I promise that the game WILL come out by the end of summer.

Stay safe out there.

- Tommy Galletta, The Guy Making Bells 'n' Whistles

notes.title: Development Update #04
notes.content:
Hello again! About another week has passed and a lot more work has been done. Recently I've been super motivated to add more things to the game, and a lot of additions and fixes have been made. 

Here's everything that's new:

 The tutorial has been completely redone in order to make it a more interactive and more enjoyable experience, and also in order to give the game a bit of personality.
 Game over messages now display each time you lose for extra character.
 Lots of code optimizations have been made, which increases the amount of customization options I have when it comes to level creation.
 There are now a whopping 4 LEVELS that have been implemented into the game, with more to come.
 All of the sound effects in the game have been completely redone.
 A lot of the art has been looked over and polished.


Ahhh... to heck with it, here's some screenshots of some of the new stuff:

As for plans over the next week or two, here's what I have in mind:

 More levels!
 Implementing background music for the menus and levels.
 Potentially getting new screenshots for the Steam page, as well as potentially beginning work on a trailer.
 A bunch of small tweaks


We're getting close to that sweet, sweet early access release, and I am very excited. Still shooting for end of May or early June (musical reference?), but like I said, as much as I would like the early access to be released then, there's no guarantee it will be. Only time will tell.

That's it for now, I hope everyone is well and staying safe! I'll see you all soon!

- Tommy Galletta, Designer of Evil but Fair Game Mechanics for Bells 'n' Whistles

notes.title: Development Update #03
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are all doing at least somewhat well in the middle of all of this Covid chaos. I don't have much news and will try to keep this brief...

After a much needed break, though it was longer than I expected, I am re-energized and ready to make more progress on this game. I've made some minor tweaks to make the gameplay experience more enjoyable, however I did not get around to making levels for the game. I have decided that it is best to polish every other aspect of the game first, as I expect level creation to be the most streamlined part of the development process for this game. Levels will be coming though, with the Early Access release soon to follow.

My hope is that the early access will be out by the end of May, however I will be taking my time, and I will only release the early access when I am satisfied with the quality and polish of the game, so it is possible it may be longer. I hope you all understand.

Anyways, that's all I have to say for now, thank you for taking some time out of your day to read this!

- Tommy Galletta, Bug Creator and Bug Fixer for Bells 'n' Whistles

notes.title: Development Update #02
notes.content:
Hello all, and thank you for reading this Development Update. I have good news! The code rewrite has been completed, and a tutorial mode has been added, as well as a bunch of other fixes to make the game a bit more user friendly. This means that all of the framework is finally in place to start creating some levels! I will be working on levels for the game essentially for the rest of the time until the game releases into early access. However, progress for the next few weeks may be a bit slow.

As you are probably aware, the spread of the Coronavirus has left many people, including myself, in a state of self-quarantine. While at first I saw this as a great opportunity to make lots of progress on Bells 'n' Whistles, after working on the game for many hours during the first few days of quarantine, I was struck with major burnout. So, I have decided to take a few days in order to brainstorm ideas for levels and relax until I feel ready to work more on the game.

Also, I would like to take a quick moment to thank everyone who has shown even the slightest bit of interest in my game. It always puts a smile on my face to see the number of wishlist adds go up by one more.

I will post the next update once I have finished creating the first few levels. Until then, have fun, stay safe, and wash you hands!

- Tommy Galletta, Director of Art, Programming, Design, and literally everything else for Bells 'n' Whistles

notes.title: Development Update #01
notes.content:
Hello to everyone who has decided to stop by and view this little project of mine! Thank you for showing interest in my game. This is the first of a series of newsletters that I hope to continue that will keep everyone interested in this game up to date on the progress that is being made.

Here's whats new:

 Lots of code is being rewritten in order to make the creation process for the game a heck of a lot easier. This process is expected to take a few days.
 A tutorial that will be accessible from the main menu of the game is in the works that will showcase each component of the gameplay and how it works. This tutorial mode will take a few days to add to the game.
 After the first two things in this list are completed, I will begin to design levels to be implemented into the game, starting with the easy levels, and slowly working my way up to the hard levels.


That's all this news I have for now. The next newsletter will be posted within the next few weeks, so if you're interested in the progress that is being made, make sure to keep your eyes peeled.

- Tommy Galletta, Lead (and only) Developer
